One, the first one that gets the higher layer payloads, put them one after the other, concatenate them, and then you add only one mark header at the beginning. And then the second one, when you get multiple mark packets, you concatenate them, creating a very large sequence, and you add only one physical header and a physical preamble. When you send everything, you first send everything to the physical layer. Okay. So in this way, you try to reduce the overhead, and therefore you can increase the efficiency.
